Dark.note: Label of the switch for the dark colour theme. On means dark.

Language.note: Read by screen readers before the name of the current language, on the button that opens the language list.

Menu.note: Button that opens and closes the sidebar on a narrow screen.

Search.note: Button that opens the search dialog.

password.note: Noun, read by screen readers after show or hide.

show.note: Button that shows the typed password. Read together with the next word as show password.

sus.bot home page.note: Name of the logo link in the top bar; it leads to the list of projects.
